edits.reason: Short current paragraph faithfully summarizes the accepted EN source as a possibility, does not promise all-investor eligibility, and immediately denies individual approval/full treaty entry into force. Therefore missing detail alone is not a blocking error. The official February statement is more specific about appropriate consideration, critical sectors and US private-sector collaboration; the optional wording makes those bounds visible.
edits.meaningPreserved: Keep the dated intention, consideration rather than approved funding, Taiwan as investment location, US side/US private partners, applicable law, and both following disclaimer sentences. No Slovenian eligibility or consultation promise.
